item.title: Your Part in God's Plan | 1 Peter 1:1-25 | Phillip Trank
item.description:
In the sermon, we are reminded that we are chosen and kept by God's sovereign power, even through seasons of grief and trials. Pastor Phillip emphasizes that our part in His plan is to simply receive and reciprocate God's love through a genuine relationship, trusting that our eternal inheritance is secure and our current suffering is only temporary. It is a powerful call for us to live with the "end in mind," finding joy in the assurance that God’s promises are proven and He will never fail us. item.title: The Power of Praise | Psalm 147:1-14 | Steve Abraham
item.description:

item.title: Fight Back | 2 Samuel 23:11-12 | Steve Abraham
item.description:
In this motivating sermon, Pastor Steve Abraham focuses on the biblical story of Shammah from 2 Samuel 23:11-12, one of David’s mighty men who stood his ground in a field of lentils when everyone else fled. He uses Shammah’s resolve to encourage you to fight back against the enemy's attempts to steal your joy, peace, and purpose. By reminding us that our "deliverance is in our defense," Pastor Steve inspires you to take a stand for your family, your calling, and your future, trusting that when you do your part, God will bring about a great victory.
Watch this message on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CuTWxUCr94s

item.title: What Do You Really Want? | John 5:2-14 | Ryan Abraham
item.description:
In the sermon "What Do You Really Want?", Pastor Ryan delivers a powerful message about the transformative nature of choosing to follow Jesus completely. He encourages you to embrace the change that comes with a life committed to Christ, reminding us that while we may feel stuck in our current season, God is a way maker who meets us in our weakness to bring healing and new purpose. It’s a heartening call to step out of spiritual complacency and experience the supernatural joy and freedom that only a full surrender to Him can provide. item.title: Cancel Comfort | Matthew 14:15-21 | Steve Abraham
item.description:
In this sermon "Cancel Comfort," Pastor Steve Abraham powerfully challenges us to trade personal ease for the purposeful, active life of a servant. By illustrating how Jesus multiplied the "not enough" of the five loaves and two fish, he encourages us to stop offering excuses and start offering our "yes" to God's call. This is a heartening reminder for everyone at New Life Oxnard that when we step out of our comfort zones to serve others, God transforms our small efforts into an overflow of restoration and blessing. item.title: BOLD FAITH | Give Me This Mountain | Joshua 14:6-13 | Steve Abraham
item.description:
In this powerful message, Pastor Steve Abraham continues our BOLD FAITH series with a deep dive into Joshua 14:6-13. Caleb’s request to "Give Me This Mountain" wasn't just about land; it was a testament to 45 years of unwavering trust in God’s promises. If you are facing "giants" or waiting for your own promised land, this message provides three practical pillars to help you move forward in faith: WATCH YOUR WORDS – Caleb didn't speak from fear; he spoke from conviction. Learn how to align your speech with God’s truth over your life and family. STAND ON THE PROMISES – Character is built on our relationship with the Word. Discover how to navigate the "wait" with the right attitude. CONFRONT YOUR GIANTS – Stop tolerating generational cycles. It’s time to drive out the giants that stand between you and your spiritual inheritance. God isn't done with your story yet. We hope this message encourages you to step into everything He has for you. This message encourages us to stay faithful, speak life-giving words, and trust God’s timing even when circumstances seem stagnant. Reflect on the importance of guarding your words, standing firm in faith, and embracing the hope found only in Jesus—the King of Kings who reigns above all earthly powers. Whether you’re facing personal battles, relational challenges, or spiritual struggles, this sermon offers hope, encouragement, and a call to keep believing no matter what. Tune in, be inspired, and let your faith be strengthened today!

item.description:
In this powerful sermon based on Mark chapter 2, Pastor Steve explores the story of four friends who, despite disappointment and obstacles, demonstrate unwavering determination to bring their paralyzed friend to Jesus for healing. He highlights three spiritual “doors”—the door of disappointment, the door of determination, and the door of deliverance—encouraging believers to persist through setbacks, fight for their breakthrough, and embrace the freedom that comes from faith in Christ. The message emphasizes the importance of faith in action, patience in God’s timing, and the transformative power of forgiveness and healing.
